record.category: Slovenian cloud drive, subscription + StackSocial lifetime

free_tier.stated: Briefcase 10/25/100 GB at EUR 0.5/1/2 per mo; Suitcase 250 GB EUR 4, 500 GB EUR 7, 1 TB EUR 10; Crate 2.5 TB EUR 20, 5 TB EUR 35; 10 TB+ on request

egress.terms: Metered by tier on PUBLIC transfers only, daily: '200 GB daily public transfer limit' (Briefcase), '1 TB daily public transfer limit' (Suitcase XL/XL+/XXL), '4 TB daily public transfer limit' (Crate). At the 5 TB tier that is ~30 TB/mo. Private/rclone traffic is not stated as capped.

record.interface_detail: rclone native `koofr` backend (Tier 2, added v1.47), WebDAV, app passwords
record.tooling: rclone native; WebDAV endpoint at app.koofr.net (probed: /api/v2.1/user returns 401 = live, auth required)
record.chaining: rclone -> anywhere; also aggregates 30 external cloud connections on the top tier
record.limits_note: Constraint type: per-ip-shaping on public links, daily granularity
record.reliability_note: Operated since 2012, Slovenian/EU. No data-loss event documented. Lifetime deal is sold through StackSocial ($159.99 with code KOOFR, 10k+ sold), not by Koofr directly, so entitlement rests on a third-party marketplace SKU.
